index_name: Ancient Wisdom Synthesis - Additional Practitioner Talks
scope_note: Curated records from publicly discoverable talks and playlists by Sanjay Rath, Vic DiCara, Shubham Alock Singh, Dennis Harness and selected Ernst Wilhelm material. Records summarise explicit titles, descriptions, chapter metadata and playlist coverage. They are not full transcript reproductions.

usage_policy.classical_authority: Practitioner records must remain separate from classical texts in ancient_wisdom.
usage_policy.exact_answer_rule: Use detailed records only for claims explicitly supported by the source metadata or later timestamp-verified transcript notes. Otherwise return Needs Verification.
usage_policy.medical_rule: Astrological, mantra, gemstone and ritual claims are traditional/practitioner interpretations and must not be presented as medical treatment or scientific causation.

records.title: Part 1: Atmakaraka, King of Your Chart, Atman Soul and Vedic Cosmology
records.summary: Introduces Atmakaraka as the principal Chara Karaka and connects the chart's soul significator with karma, rebirth and Vedic cosmology. Useful for explaining why the app calculates Atmakaraka, but detailed planet-specific conclusions require transcript-level notes.
records.verification_status: public description verified

records.title: King Vimshottari
records.summary: An advanced treatment of Vimshottari Dasha. The speaker explicitly cautions that the presentation is not for novices. Use as advanced practitioner context after the app's deterministic Mahadasha calculation, not as a replacement for that calculation.
records.verification_status: official channel description verified

records.title: Vimshottari Dasa Types - Parts 1 to 4
records.summary: A multi-part series covering types and applications of Vimshottari Dasha, including Kevala. Suitable for advanced timing interpretation after the app's basic Mahadasha and Antardasha engine is verified.
records.verification_status: playlist titles verified; transcript expansion needed

records.title: Bhavat Bhavam - Identifying Curses, Remedies and Mantra
records.summary: Presents Bhavat Bhavam and explicitly connects the topic with identifying difficult patterns and applying remedies/mantra. Any claim involving curses requires great caution and should never be presented as objective fact or used to frighten users.
records.verification_status: public title and description verified

records.title: Graha Tattva, Characters and Mantra
records.summary: Explores planetary principles and character together with mantra and the importance of Bhagya/ninth-house themes. Detailed planet-by-planet mappings require timestamp-level notes before exact recommendations.
records.verification_status: playlist title verified; transcript expansion needed

records.title: Devata of Planets
records.summary: Addresses deities associated with planetary forces. Use only after detailed transcript/timestamp verification, especially before recommending a deity, mantra or ritual to a user.
records.verification_status: playlist title verified; transcript expansion needed

records.title: Rudraksha Vidya and Rudraksha Mukhi Series
records.summary: A substantial official-channel series on Rudraksha Vidya and individual Mukhi types. The app should treat Rudraksha selection as specialist traditional guidance and must not infer a bead recommendation from the title alone.
records.verification_status: official playlist verified; transcript expansion needed

records.title: Panchakshari Vidya Series
records.summary: An official series devoted to Panchakshari Vidya and introductory material. Detailed practice conditions, pronunciation and initiation requirements require transcript-level verification.
records.verification_status: official channel playlist verified; transcript expansion needed

records.title: Graha Planetary Yuddha and One Remedy
records.summary: A short talk on Graha Yuddha and a remedy. Exact remedy details must not be generated until verified from the talk itself.
records.verification_status: playlist title verified; transcript expansion needed

records.title: Kal Sarpa Yoga and Kaal Amrita Yoga - Their Remedy
records.summary: Discusses Kal Sarpa and Kaal Amrita configurations and remedial approaches. The app must avoid fear-based diagnosis and should require verified chart rules and source details before mentioning these configurations.
records.verification_status: playlist title verified; transcript expansion needed

records.title: Vedic Mantra for the Sun and Moon

records.summary: A dedicated session on Vedic mantras associated with Mercury and Venus. Exact recitation details and applicability require verification.

records.title: Astrological Remedies from Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra - Three-Part Series

records.title: Planetary Symbolism Series
records.summary: A collection of talks on key symbolism of the major planets and lunar nodes. Useful for plain-language explanations, but each planet should be expanded into its own timestamped summary before exact-answer use.

records.title: Nakshatra Symbolism and Life-Lesson Series
records.summary: A broad series on Nakshatra symbolism and related life lessons. It can complement Dennis Harness, but the app should keep speaker-specific interpretation separate from classical Nakshatra sources.
records.verification_status: playlist titles verified; individual expansion needed

records.title: Mantra as a Remedy - Part 1
records.summary: Introduces how mantra may be used as a traditional response to an astrological problem. This is part of a four-video series; exact selection rules and practice instructions require the complete series and transcript-level notes.
records.verification_status: public title and description verified

records.title: Remedies of Planets and Signs in Vedic Astrology
records.summary: Discusses remedial approaches linked to planets and signs and points toward related teachings on gemstones, spiritual practices and Devi-oriented remedies. Exact planet-by-planet instructions require timestamp verification.
records.verification_status: public title and description verified

records.title: Gemstones, Remedies, Karma, Purana Lakshana and Informal Talk
records.summary: Discusses gemstones and remedial practice within worship, kriya, prayoga and Tantric tradition. Gemstone advice must remain specialist-only until chart strength, house rulership, dignity, combustion, aspects and current Dasha are calculated.
records.verification_status: public title and description verified

records.title: Donations as Remedy
records.summary: Explores donation as a remedial and ethical practice, including how donation may be made more meaningful. Exact conditions and scriptural claims require episode-level verification.
records.verification_status: channel episode title verified; transcript expansion needed

records.title: The Greatest Remedy - Sattva Guna
records.summary: Frames development of Sattva as a broad remedial principle. This can support low-risk behavioural recommendations, provided the app does not oversimplify complex health or life problems.
records.verification_status: channel episode title verified; transcript expansion needed

records.title: Deity, Mantra, Yantra and Paths of Spirituality
records.summary: Discusses the relationship among deity, mantra, yantra and spiritual paths. The app should use this to explain categories, not to auto-prescribe advanced practices without exact guidance.
records.verification_status: channel episode title verified; transcript expansion needed

records.summary: Introduces Yantra usage and importance within the speaker's practitioner framework. Specific Yantra selection and consecration requirements need transcript-level verification.

records.title: The Nakshatras - Introduction
records.summary: Introduces Nakshatras as 27 lunar mansions represented by deities or cosmic energies, with each Nakshatra colouring a planet placed within it with a particular dynamic.
records.verification_status: public description verified

records.title: Secrets of Each Nakshatra
records.summary: A broad teaching on the individual Nakshatras and their symbolic, psychological and spiritual meanings. Each Nakshatra needs its own timestamped record before the app can answer exact questions about all 27.
records.verification_status: public title and speaker context verified; detailed expansion needed

records.title: The Spirituality of Nakshatras
records.summary: Explores the spiritual dimension of Nakshatras and their use for self-awareness and development rather than only prediction.
records.verification_status: public description verified

records.title: Nakshatras and Compatibility Secrets
records.summary: Discusses how Nakshatras may be used to understand relationship patterns and strengths. The app should not present this as deterministic compatibility or a basis for consequential relationship decisions.
records.verification_status: public description verified

records.title: Nakshatras and Professions
records.summary: Explores career and professional tendencies through Nakshatra interpretation. Use as reflective practitioner material, not as a deterministic career assessment.
records.verification_status: public title and description verified

records.title: Relationship Potential and Compatibility
records.summary: Discusses relationship potential and the therapeutic interpretive importance of Nakshatras. The app should use this for self-reflection and communication prompts, not decisions about marriage or separation.
records.verification_status: public description verified

records.title: Why Are There So Many Ayanamshas in Vedic Astrology?
records.summary: Discusses why multiple ayanamsa systems exist. Useful for methodology disclosure, but the app's calculation engine remains frozen to Lahiri/Chitrapaksha unless the user explicitly chooses another validated option.
records.verification_status: public title and description verified

records.title: Secrets of Rahu in Vedic Astrology
records.summary: A dedicated discussion of Rahu. Detailed interpretive claims require transcript-level expansion before exact-answer use.
records.verification_status: public title verified; transcript expansion needed

records.title: New Rashi Sutras in the Context of Lajjitaadi Avasthas and Rahu/Ketu
records.summary: Discusses how planetary Avasthas condition signs and psychological patterns, including Rahu/Ketu themes. This is an alternative interpretive framework and must be labelled separately from the app's classical calculation layer.
records.verification_status: published chapter metadata verified

records.title: Jyotish Techniques, Avasthas, Ayanamsa and Galactic Centre
records.summary: A methodological discussion of Jyotish techniques, Avasthas and ayanamsa. Useful for expert-level context about interpretive differences, not for changing the current Lahiri calculation silently.
records.verification_status: public description verified
